features:
Aim Settings: NPC silent aim, crosshair-based targeting, 360° Enrage, head/body/random targeting, torso fallback, target highlight, adjustable radius, FOV circle, and smooth target swapping.
Weapon Settings: zero spread/recoil, hitscan, infinite ammo, adjustable fire rate, semi/auto/burst modes, wall shots, and infinite penetration.
Vehicle Settings: horse/car/bike speed and acceleration, infinite horse sprint, and improved road grip.
Autofarm: automatic weapon collection, NPC targeting and firing, configurable hover height and timing, stuck-target skipping, and kill/money/boss statistics.
Auto Nuke: required-item collection, launch-step automation, scheduled/manual attempts, cancellation, evacuation, and Doomsday Clock.
Item Repossession: automatically collects weapons, items, or both, with pickup timing and quantity controls.
Physical Enhancements: walk speed, jump height, gravity, flight, run-and-gun, click teleport, and noclip, with configurable bindings.
Visual Enhancements: Silent Eye targeting colours, Malice Radar danger colours, Omnisight, Six Eyes, health bars, names, distances, custom colours, fullbright, tracers, and bullet trails.
Map: circular NPC radar, danger/elevation colours, player marker, viewing/targeting cone, grid, distance labels, adjustable range, and rebindable M toggle.
Item Finder: searchable item locations, cached discoveries, highlights, direction/distance/coordinates, route arrows, scanning, and confirmed teleport.
Settings: interface colours, rebindable Right Shift hide key, Disable All shortcut, runtime, tooltips, and credits.
Staff Protection: detects listed staff/influencer roles, identifies them in a popup, and disables active features.
Hidden Observer Alert: warns and disables features after suspicious repeated nearby movement by an invisible character (Admin detection).
Paranoia Protocol: possible-viewer estimates, pink player boxes/map dots, range/angle settings, blinking observation light, and rebindable K toggle.

comments.text: @cvexe so ive found a possible reason why the bullets are missing - the aim point is chosen right before the shot has actually been created and shot so the shot could miss as its shooting at where it was right before the bullet was shot, the fall back also counts missed shots due to spread (which can be set to zero spread) as failed headshots so it could cause it to target torso when it should be targeting the head, ive changed it to now the aimpoint is set at the time the shot is fired so it should now no longer miss (providing the npc has a valid head hitbox as some dont, hence the fallback) hitscan has also been set to on by default, also added player esp GUI next to the Map button on the visual enhancements tab. So hopefully it shouldnt miss now but lmk (if zero spread is off it can still miss due to the spread of the weapon) edit: have now added configs
